mnl_validation.note: Independent real DCE with coded (unlabelled) attributes. Validates the harness's conditional-logit estimator — NOT the LLM engine. Hit rate >0.33 and pseudo-R2 >0 mean the estimator recovers real preference structure.

notes: Ranking-conjoint correlation with the real ranking: 0.23 (single-respondent dataset — one data point only).

Choice-conjoint, UNGROUNDED engine (real 72-task DCE): apple-type Spearman -0.40, freshness 1.00, price direction 100%. A negative type score means the raw engine ranks product preference partly backwards — it is fooled by flattering product names.

Choice-conjoint, RAG-GROUNDED engine: apple-type Spearman -0.10 (a +0.30 swing vs ungrounded). RAG + chain-of-thought neutralised most of the name bias but did not install correct positive signal — the LLM's brand-name prior is only partly curable in-context.

Harness self-check: the conditional-logit estimator was validated on an independent real DCE (Potsdamer, 85 tasks) — hit rate 0.56 vs a 0.33 chance baseline, McFadden pseudo-R2 0.15. The harness's statistical core generalises beyond the apple data.
